elements.name: Aspect of the Beast (Bear)
elements.desc: Your carrying capacity doubles, and you have advantage on Strength checks to push, pull, lift, or break objects.

elements.name: Aspect of the Beast (Eagle)
elements.desc: You can see up to 1 mile away with no difficulty, and dim light doesn't impose disadvantage on Perception checks.

elements.name: Aspect of the Beast (Wolf)
elements.desc: You can track at a fast pace, and move stealthily at a normal pace.

elements.name: Breath of Winter
elements.desc: Spend 6 ki points to cast cone of cold.

elements.id: Class Feature:Clench of the North Wind
elements.name: Clench of the North Wind
elements.desc: Spend 3 ki points to cast hold person.

elements.name: Commander’s Strike
elements.desc: Bonus action: forgo one attack; an ally uses its reaction to attack a target you can see, adding your superiority die to the damage.

elements.name: Disarming Attack
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; target must make a Strength save or drop a held item.

elements.name: Distracting Strike
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; the next attack against the target by anyone other than you has advantage.

elements.name: Eternal Mountain Defense
elements.desc: Spend 5 ki points to cast stoneskin on yourself.

elements.name: Evasive Footwork
elements.desc: When you move, add your superiority die to your AC until you stop moving.

elements.id: Class Feature:Fangs of the Fire Snake
elements.name: Fangs of the Fire Snake
elements.desc: Spend 1 ki point to extend your unarmed reach by 10 feet and deal fire damage; spend 1 more on a hit for an extra 1d10 fire damage.

elements.name: Feinting Attack
elements.desc: Bonus action: choose a creature within 5 feet; you have advantage on your next attack against it this turn, and add your superiority die to its damage.

elements.name: Fist of Four Thunders
elements.desc: Spend 2 ki points to cast thunderwave.

elements.name: Fist of Unbroken Air
elements.desc: Spend 2 or more ki points to blast a creature for 3d10 bludgeoning damage and push it away (Strength save).

elements.name: Flames of the Phoenix
elements.desc: Spend 4 ki points to cast fireball.

elements.name: Goading Attack
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; target must make a Wisdom save or have disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.

elements.name: Gong of the Summit
elements.desc: Spend 3 ki points to cast shatter.

elements.name: Lunging Attack
elements.desc: On your turn, increase your reach by 5 feet for one melee weapon attack, and add your superiority die to its damage.

elements.name: Maneuvering Attack
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; choose a friendly creature, which can move half its speed as a reaction without provoking opportunity attacks.

elements.name: Menacing Attack
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; target must make a Wisdom save or be frightened of you.

elements.name: Mist Stance
elements.desc: Spend 4 ki points to cast gaseous form on yourself.

elements.name: Parry
elements.desc: Reaction: reduce damage from a melee attack by your superiority die + your Dexterity modifier.

elements.name: Precision Attack
elements.desc: When you make a weapon attack, add your superiority die to the attack roll.

elements.name: Pushing Attack
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; target must make a Strength save or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

elements.name: Ride the Wind
elements.desc: Spend 4 ki points to cast fly on yourself.

elements.name: Riposte
elements.desc: Reaction: when a creature misses you with a melee attack, make a melee weapon attack against it, adding your superiority die to the damage.

elements.name: River of Hungry Flame
elements.desc: Spend 5 ki points to cast wall of fire.

elements.id: Class Feature:Rush of the Gale Spirits
elements.name: Rush of the Gale Spirits
elements.desc: Spend 2 ki points to cast gust of wind.

elements.name: Shape the Flowing River
elements.desc: Spend 1 ki point to reshape ice or water in a 30-foot area.

elements.name: Sweeping Attack
elements.desc: When you hit with a melee weapon, choose another creature within 5 feet of the target; it takes damage equal to your superiority die of the weapon's type.

elements.name: Sweeping Cinder Strike
elements.desc: Spend 2 ki points to cast burning hands.

elements.name: Totem Spirit (Bear)
elements.desc: While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic damage.

elements.name: Totem Spirit (Eagle)
elements.desc: While raging and not in heavy armor, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage, and you can Dash as a bonus action.

elements.name: Totem Spirit (Wolf)
elements.desc: While raging, your friends have advantage on melee attack rolls against hostile creatures within 5 feet of you.

elements.name: Totemic Attunement (Bear)
elements.desc: While raging, hostile creatures within 5 feet of you have disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you.

elements.name: Totemic Attunement (Eagle)
elements.desc: While raging, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed (you can't hover).

elements.name: Totemic Attunement (Wolf)
elements.desc: While raging, you can knock a Large or smaller creature prone as a bonus action when you hit it with a melee weapon attack.

elements.name: Trip Attack
elements.desc: On a hit, add your superiority die to damage; target must make a Strength save or be knocked prone.

elements.name: Water Whip
elements.desc: Spend 2 or more ki points to lash a creature for 3d10 bludgeoning damage and pull or knock it prone (Dexterity save).

elements.name: Wave of Rolling Earth
elements.desc: Spend 6 ki points to cast wall of stone.
